what: Analytics/telemetry is ENABLED by default (telemetryEnabled = true). Users opt OUT with `aide-memory config telemetry.enabled false`. User explicitly corrected the opposite — they want users sharing analytics by default for product visibility.
why: User corrected me twice on this. "No I want analytics opt in to be true by default i.e users share analytics by default." The config check looks for telemetry.enabled === false to disable, not === true to enable.
